facts.fact: Public Digital reports Madagascar's Digital Governance Unit built the multi-channel public services portal Torolalana, whose in-person channel Mahatoky has been piloted in 4 post offices, supports 400 processes and holds 206 citizen accounts, with transactional services still to be added to the informative ones offered.

systems.owner: Digital Governance Unit, Ministry of Digital Development
systems.tiers: digital channel, telephone channel, physical channel (Mahatoky)
